about: Jon L. Norinsberg operates from his office at Norinsberg Law in New York City, New York, where he passionately advocates for individuals throughout the metropolis. As the senior partner, he efficiently navigates complex legal landscapes, focusing on civil rights, employment and labor law, and personal injury cases. His extensive experience encompasses a wide array of issues, such as car accidents, premises liability, construction accidents, medical malpractice, products liability and wrongful death, ensuring comprehensive legal support for his clients.

Drawing on more than 30 years of extensive legal experience, Mr. Norinsberg is dedicated to offering thorough and compassionate representation to individuals living in New York City who have faced significant violations of their fundamental rights or constitutional protections. His commitment to justice ensures that clients receive not only legal assistance but also the support they need during challenging times. He strives to empower those who have been wronged, advocating fiercely on their behalf to uphold their rights and secure suitable outcomes.

Earning his bachelor’s degree from the University of Pennsylvania, Mr. Norinsberg went on to pursue his legal education at Georgetown Law. He received his Juris Doctor in 1991, and in the following year was admitted to practice law in New York. Furthermore, he is licensed to appear before the U.S. District Court for the Southern and Eastern Districts of New York, and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 2nd Circuit.

With an inherent passion to be the voice for those who are left with no other legal options, Mr. Norinsberg has continuously strived to fight for justice on the behalf of his clients. This commitment of his led to successful compensation for his clients, recovering millions in settlements and verdicts. His efforts in some of the biggest judgments were acknowledged and he was invited to join the Multi-Million Dollar Advocates Forum.
